cohort: The study participants were pregnant and puerperal women diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 infection who were hospitalized at Hospital Nacional Daniel Alcides Carrion, Callao, Peru.
finding: The behavior of SARS-CoV-2 infection in the studied pregnant women was similar to that observed in the general population of the same age.
mod_finding: Among the deliveries, 69% were vaginal and 31% were via cesarean section.
